en.title: SANDISK 128GB microSD Card, Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition, 2-Pack
bullets: The official licensed microSD card for Nintendo Switch Systems
Designed, tested, and approved for Nintendo Switch Systems
Add games fast with write speeds up to 90MB/s (Based on internal testing; performance may be lower depending upon host device, interface, usage conditions and other factors. 1MB = 1,000,000 bytes.)

Start playing fast with read speeds up to 100MB/s (Based on internal testing; performance may be lower depending upon host device, interface, usage conditions and other factors. 1MB = 1,000,000 bytes.)
Store an entire game collection, plus screenshots and videos, with up to 128GB of additional memory (1GB=1,000,000,000 bytes. Actual user storage less.)
This product is not designed for the Nintendo Switch 2. For compatible Nintendo Switch 2 storage, shop the ‘SanDisk microSD Express Card – Works with Nintendo Switch 2’ model.
en.description: With incredible speed, the official licensed SanDisk microSDXC card for the Nintendo Switch System lets you add up to 128GB of space to your system. Spend less time waiting and more time gaming with read and write speeds of up to 100MB/s and 90MB/s respectively. (1GB=1,000,000,000 bytes. Actual user storage less. Based on internal testing; performance may be lower depending upon host device, interface, usage conditions and other factors. 1MB = 1,000,000 bytes.)
